theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (y₀ : Euclid (n + 1)), IsOpen W → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → y₀ ∈ W → fderiv ℝ F y₀ ≠ 0 → ∃ (D : Set (Euclid n)) (Λ : Euclid n → Euclid (n + 1)) (c : Euclid n) (ρ : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), IsOpen D ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Λ D ∧ InjOn Λ D ∧ (∀ z ∈ D, Λ z ∈ W ∧ F (Λ z) = F y₀ ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ Λ z) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Λ z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ F (Λ z) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) ∧ closedBall c ρ ⊆ D ∧ IsOpen N ∧ y₀ ∈ N ∧ N ∩ F ⁻¹' {F y₀} ⊆ Λ '' ball c ρ
